We are on holiday and only made the appointment as we were very concerned about ongoing symptoms over some months which had got worse. We would never had done this if we hadn’t been extremely worried which he failed to pick up on. She came out of the appointment and cried. I felt terrible as I hadn’t advocated strongly enough for her and hadn’t got all the information across due to his abrupt and dismissive nature.
